stories.title: Enforce Disciplinary Signal Response Contract
stories.description: Implement strict response schema validation within provider_detail_service to ensure the disciplinary signal only includes an availability indicator and a validated state medical board lookup URL, explicitly preventing inclusion of detailed disciplinary records.

stories.title: Integrate URL Validation for Medical Board Links
stories.description: Integrate URL Guardian validation to ensure all generated state medical board links are reachable, safe, and correctly formatted before being returned as part of the disciplinary signal.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Disciplinary Signal Delivery
stories.description: Create integration tests validating the full flow from provider lookup (NPI) through provider_detail_service to Evaluate Care facade, ensuring disciplinary signals are correctly constructed, validated, and included in final responses.
